outcome: prevalence of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy
cohort: Pregnancies at three tertiary care Australian hospitals over a 36-month period.
finding: Women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy had a lower gestational age at delivery, lower birth weight, and increased special care nursery admissions compared to those without.
gest_age: Median of 36.4 weeks for pregnancies with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy and 38.6 weeks for other pregnancies
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was lower in the intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy group (3.12 kg) compared to the non-intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy group (3.31 kg)
